newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU wheat exports lag last year's pace, barley up.
newsitem.headline: EU wheat exports lag last year's pace, barley up.

text.p: European Union commercial soft wheat exports were running at 39 percent of their year-ago rate on October 1, member country grain officials said on Monday.
Total grain exports between July 1 and October 1 were at 70 percent of last year's comparable figure but barley exports were about 1.7 times higher than the year-ago volume, they said.
The figures, based on known export commitments, were distributed to member countries at the EU's weekly cereals management committee meeting on October 3.
They show that commercial soft wheat grain exports were at 1.135 million tonnes compared with 2.885 million.
Commercial barley export commitments stood at 1.449 million tonnes on October 1, up from 860,000 tonnes a year before.
Total exports including processed products were at 4.614 million tonnes compared with 6.593 million on October 1, 1995.
Total imports had dropped to 502,000 tonnes by October 1, from 2.145 million tonnes at the same point last year.
